candidates.comment: A diagnostic test or procedure offered by a diagnostic lab. Also called: lab test, diagnostic offering, test procedure. Examples: "DiagnosticLab 'LabCorp' availableTest 'Blood Test'", "DiagnosticLab 'Imaging Center' availableTest 'MRI Scan'."

candidates.label: usedToDiagnose
candidates.comment: A used to diagnose relation between a medical test and a medical condition it is employed to identify. Also called diagnoses, identifies condition, screens for. Examples: "MedicalTest 'MRI' usedToDiagnose 'Brain Tumor'", "MedicalTest 'Blood Test' usedToDiagnose 'Anemia'", "MedicalTest 'X-ray' usedToDiagnose 'Fracture'".

candidates.label: usesDevice
candidates.comment: A uses device relation between a medical test and the medical device employed to perform it. Also called device used, equipment for test, test instrument. Examples: "MedicalTest 'Ultrasound' usesDevice 'Ultrasound Scanner'", "MedicalTest 'ECG' usesDevice 'Electrocardiograph'", "MedicalTest 'Blood Pressure Measurement' usesDevice 'Sphygmomanometer'".

candidates.label: tissueSample
candidates.comment: A tissue sample relation between a pathology test and the type of tissue required for it. Also called sample type, biopsy type, specimen type. Examples: "Biopsy test tissueSample 'liver tissue'", "Pathology test tissueSample 'lymph node'", "Diagnostic test tissueSample 'skin biopsy'".

candidates.label: preparation
candidates.comment: A medical attribute describing the typical preparation a patient must undergo before a medical procedure. Also called patient readiness, pre-procedure instructions, pre-op preparation. Examples: A medical procedure requires preparation like 'fasting for 8 hours'. The surgery involves preparation such as 'blood tests'. The diagnostic test needs preparation including 'avoiding certain medications'.

candidates.label: assesses
candidates.comment: A relation between a creative work, education event, or learning resource and the competency or learning outcome it is intended to evaluate. Also called: evaluates, measures, tests, gauges. Examples: "LearningResource 'Quiz' assesses 'Understanding of Algebra'", "EducationEvent 'Exam' assesses 'Problem-solving skills'", "CreativeWork 'Rubric' assesses 'Writing proficiency'."

candidates.label: subTest
candidates.comment: A component relation between a medical test panel and an individual medical test that is part of the panel. Also called "panel component", "included test", "part of test panel". Examples: "The blood panel has subTest a cholesterol test", "The medical test panel's subTest is a glucose measurement", "This panel includes several subTest procedures."
